summary: Deflate-style Huffman bitstream encoder. If the block counter at a1+122 is non-positive, the tree-rebuild stage is skipped; otherwise, when the block type at a1+28 is 2 the checksum is validated via BufferChecksumValidator, two Huffman trees are built via sub_5383D0 over the arrays at a1+2830 and a1+2842, and PerformanceSectorTimeAccumulator computes the bit-cost used during flushing. Byte budgets v7/v8 are derived from the bit counters at a1+5787 and a1+5791 ((value + 10) >> 3). When a2 is set and a3+4 fits the budget, the symbol is written raw via BitstreamWriteBits; otherwise the symbol (a4+2 or a4+4 extra bits, depending on which budget branch) is packed into the 16-bit accumulator at a1+5803 under the bit cursor a1+5805, flushing full bytes to the output cursor (a1+8 + a1+20) when the cursor exceeds 13 bits, rebuilding the fixed code table via HuffmanBitStreamDecoder(&unk_5B8280) on the literal path or the dynamic table at a1+2430 on the distance path, and flushing the buffered stream via BitBufferWriter. ScorecardZero resets the frequency/cost accumulators for the next block, and a non-zero a4 triggers a final UnicodeBufferFlusher.

local_names.a1: encoder state object (bit buffer at +5803/+5805, output cursor at +8/+20, tree arrays at +2830/+2842/+2430)
local_names.a2: raw-write gate; when set and the budget allows, symbols are written with BitstreamWriteBits instead of packed
local_names.a3: symbol length/value used for both the raw-write path and the bit-budget arithmetic (a3+4, a3+5)
local_names.a4: extra-bits value; also the final-flush selector (non-zero triggers UnicodeBufferFlusher)
local_names.v5: bit-cost accumulated by PerformanceSectorTimeAccumulator, consumed by BitBufferWriter
local_names.v7: byte budget from the a1+5787 bit counter
local_names.v8: byte budget from the a1+5791 bit counter; v8 == v7 selects the literal packing branch

operations.description: Block gate: when the dword block counter at a1+122 is <= 0, the tree rebuild and checksum stage is skipped and the budget falls back to a3+5; otherwise the full encoder path runs.
Block-type check: when the byte at a1+28 is 2 (compressed), the buffer checksum is validated via BufferChecksumValidator(a1) before the trees are rebuilt.
Build the two Huffman trees: sub_5383D0(a1, a1+2830) and sub_5383D0(a1, a1+2842) construct the literal/length and distance trees from their frequency arrays.
Accumulate the encoding bit-cost: PerformanceSectorTimeAccumulator(a1) returns v5, later passed to BitBufferWriter for the flush.
Bit-budget arithmetic: v7 = (dword at a1+5787 + 10) >> 3 and v8 = (dword at a1+5791 + 10) >> 3; when v8 <= v7 the smaller budget v8 is used.
Raw-write branch: when a2 is set and a3+4 <= v7, the symbol is written directly with BitstreamWriteBits(a1, a3, a4) instead of being packed.

Symbol packing: with the bit cursor v11 read from a1+5805, the value a4+2 (v8 == v7 literal path) or a4+4 (distance path) is shifted left by v11 and OR-ed into the 16-bit accumulator at a1+5803; when v11 <= 13 the cursor is advanced by 3.

Byte flush when the cursor v11 exceeds 13: the low byte of a1+5803 is stored at the output cursor (a1+8 + a1+20), then the high byte at a1+5804 is stored at cursor +1, a1+20 advances by 2, the cursor at a1+5805 is reduced by 13, and the remaining shifted bits stay in a1+5803.
Rebuild the fixed/global code table: HuffmanBitStreamDecoder(&unk_5B8280) assigns the reverse codes for the shared static tree used on the literal path.
Flush the buffered bitstream: BitBufferWriter(a1+2846 + 1, v5 + 1) writes the pending output bytes on the distance path.
Rebuild the dynamic length tree code table: HuffmanBitStreamDecoder(a1 + 2430) assigns the reverse codes for the tree stored at a1+2430.
Reset per-block accumulators: ScorecardZero(a1) zeroes the frequency/cost state and its return value becomes the function result when a4 is zero.
Final flush: when a4 (retained as v9) is non-zero the function returns UnicodeBufferFlusher() instead of the ScorecardZero result.

The mapping of the tree arrays at a1+2830 (literal/length) and a1+2842 (distance) is an interpretation from the existing analysis fill, not independently evidenced; the same applies to the roles of a1+5803/a1+5805 as a bit accumulator/cursor.
The meaning of the a2 parameter (raw-write gate) and of the a1+28 block-type encoding (2 = compressed) is inferred from deflate semantics and the fill, not proven.
